actual.oneFailedSaveBeforeCommit: INTERNAL_FAILURE in returned result and later healthy final checkpoint; only I1_NATIVE_CHECKPOINT_ACK_MISSING remains
actual.lostAckAfterCommit: Returned INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and unadvanced committed checkpoint; first provider error absent. Conservative degradation is allowed, erasure of prior evidence is the issue.
actual.nativeIntent: RESPOND RUNNING precedes provider, final FAILED row remains
actual.committedUsage: modelCalls=1, inputTokens=0, outputTokens=0, costUsd=0; no observed model result. This is a conservative native hold, not proof of zero actual provider cost.
actual.recoveries: Two recreated-factory recoveries return STATE_CONFLICT; no extra provider/tool entry or checkpoint/journal mutation.

findings.confidence: HIGH on exact copied candidate and local native stores; no provider/PG/billing inference
findings.repairDirection: Retain the original outcome/error as first failure evidence when usage persistence fails; represent secondary checkpoint uncertainty explicitly. Do not invent ACK, settled usage, counters, decision receipts, or permission to replay. No repair was made by I1.
